mu_name_from: The Lost Tower's object slot 25, the model index: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd (MapManager.cpp:1121-1123).
sheet_from: Data/Object5/t17, 64 square, already decoded under the tower's lt_ prefix.
sheet_materials_from: Read off the sheet: grey stone carved with a ring and a scroll border, the floor's own flagstone.
why_this_one: The Meteorite Trap, OpenMU's NPC 103: MuMain hides type 25 as scenery (HiddenMesh -2, ZzzObject.cpp:4026-4028) and draws the live trap from this model (CreateCharacter(Key, 25, ...), ZzzCharacter.cpp:14283-14284). A 1.25 m square plate, four triangles, laid on each of the 148 trap tiles by game/world/trap_show.h.
sheet_grade_from: Ours, as the floor machines' (Object20, Object21): the plate's grey t17 graded to the main walls' warm re_04 (lt_t17_warm) and its relief at 0.35, so it lies in the same masonry rather than going blue under the cold key (the user, 2026-10-01: 'somewthing wroong with color for traps, not intergrated well').
